build_ast_from_source: build an AST from C++ source code using BuilderFromSource and AstBuilder.Generate
print_identifiers: print all identifiers from a C++ source file using PrintIndentifiers with a filter predicate
parse_class_declaration: parse a C++ class declaration into a Class AST node with bases, body, and templated types
parse_method_signature: parse a C++ method signature into a Method AST node with return type, parameters, and modifiers
summarize_ast_nodes: summarize all AST nodes from a C++ file by iterating AstBuilder.Generate and printing each node
